subject_lines: We have the requirement. Here is what happens next.
Your build is on the calendar
From requirement to handoff: where we start
sequences.body: Thanks for bringing the requirement to us. The short version of what you've signed up for: one team carries framing, behavior, product, engineering, and handoff inside a single delivery loop. What happens next: 1. We confirm the kickoff time and who joins from your side. 2. We open with the requirement: the problem, the people who will use the system, and the way you want to run it. 3. From there we design, build, and hand it back in a form your team can own. You will always talk to the operators doing the work, not an account layer.

subject_lines: Where the loop is right now
Quick note on where we are
sequences.body: Quick note on where the loop is right now: [stage name]. Here is what we have, what we're doing next, and what we need from you. [Specific progress items]. [Specific next step]. Nothing is at risk. If you have questions, reply to this email.

The requirement is locked. Here is the framing we landed on: [brief description of the locked requirement]. The next stage is system design — interface and operating logic together, with user behavior treated as part of the system. From here: [timeline]. If anything in the locked requirement needs adjustment, this is the right moment to flag it.

The system shipped to production. What was framed is what we built — the loop held. Next stage is handoff: documentation, training, control surfaces, the Ownership Transfer Pack. From here: [handoff timeline]. You inherit a system you can run, extend, and own without us.

subject_lines: The system is yours to run
sequences.body: The system is yours to run. Here is what you inherit: a running system, not a deck disconnected from shipped reality. Documentation written to be read by the team that will run it. Control surfaces and operational artifacts that keep the system legible. A model of the problem you can carry forward without us. We are not an always-on retainer. If a new entangled requirement appears, you can come back for a new engagement.
sequences.cta: Reach out when you need us
